title: From NHS to Private Practice: A Psychologist's Journey

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 各位心理学家，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取报酬之外的钱，会怎样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性的收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”课程现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可规模化的产品，例如课程、会员计划和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己在2022年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家完成他们的学习之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属推广链接加入，你将获得Sophie提供的奖励，以及我额外提供的专属支持方案，无需支付任何额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师课、个性化指导、一份Fortnum and Mason礼品，以及限时的一对一教练辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 点击描述栏中的链接，前往我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，随时可以找我。

sentences.en: Do certain types of psychologists feel more drawn to private practice?
sentences.zh: 是否某些类型的心理学家更容易被私人执业所吸引？

sentences.en: And how does imposter syndrome play into the decision to take the leap?
sentences.zh: 冒名顶替综合征在决定迈出这一步时又扮演了什么角色？

sentences.en: In today's episode, I am joined by Dr. Rosie Gilderthorpe, and together we'll explore her journey from NHS into private practice,
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我邀请到了 Rosie Gilderthorpe 博士，我们将一起探讨她从英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）转向私人执业的历程，

sentences.en: the kind of clinician she was, and the challenges and rewards of building a psychology business.
sentences.zh: 聊聊她曾经是怎样的临床医生，以及建立心理学业务所面临的挑战与收获。

sentences.en: Whether you're wondering what private practice is or curious about whether it could be a good step for you, stay tuned for insights that might just change your perspective.
sentences.zh: 无论你是想了解什么是私人执业，还是好奇它是否适合你，请继续收听，这些见解或许会改变你的看法。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 你好，欢迎收听《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne, and it's my pleasure to be here for you as a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安医生，很高兴能以一名合格临床心理学家的身份在这里为您提供服务。

sentences.en: I say it's my pleasure to be here because, of course, being in private practice gives me more options to be able to choose how I use my time.
sentences.zh: 之所以说很高兴能在这里，是因为私人执业确实让我有更多选择，能自主决定如何利用我的时间。

sentences.en: This is definitely something that gave me many headaches when I was in the NHS.
sentences.zh: 这在我在英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）工作时，确实让我感到非常头疼。

sentences.en: I hope you'll find today's episode a really useful look into what private practice is and what fantastic opportunities it creates for you to be the kind of clinician you want to be,
sentences.zh: 希望今天的节目能让您深入了解什么是私人执业，以及它如何为您创造绝佳的机会，让您成为自己想成为的那种临床医生，

sentences.en: and one that creates opportunities for services where you know there ought to be a better provision.
sentences.zh: 并为您创造机会去提供那些您认为本应有更好服务的领域。

sentences.en: If you do find this content helpful and you're watching on YouTube, please do like, please do subscribe, please do drop me a comment.
sentences.zh: 如果您觉得这些内容有帮助，并且正在 YouTube 上观看，请务必点赞、订阅并给我留言。

sentences.en: Consider sharing it with people in your network too.
sentences.zh: 也请考虑将其分享给您人脉圈中的朋友。

sentences.en: If you are listening as an MP3, please do share this episode.
sentences.zh: 如果您是在收听 MP3 音频，也请分享这一期节目。

sentences.en: Please do subscribe, follow the show, and if you're on Spotify, you can ask me questions on there too.
sentences.zh: 请务必订阅并关注本节目，如果您在 Spotify 上收听，也可以在上面向我提问。

sentences.en: And on Apple Podcasts, please do rate and review.
sentences.zh: 在 Apple Podcasts 上，也请务必给予评分和评论。

sentences.en: Hope you find this useful and I'll catch up with you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 希望您觉得这些内容有用，我们稍后见。

sentences.en: Hi, I just want to welcome along our guest for today, Dr. Rosie Gildethorpe.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我想欢迎我们今天的嘉宾，罗西·吉尔德索普医生。

sentences.en: Hi, Rosie.
sentences.zh: 你好，罗西。

sentences.en: Hello, it's lovely to be here.
sentences.zh: 你好，很高兴能来到这里。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me on.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: Well, thank you for being here.
sentences.zh: 也谢谢你能来。

sentences.en: And it was lovely to meet you in person recently as well, which is where the idea for this episode came from.
sentences.zh: 而且最近能亲自见到你真是太好了，这一期节目的灵感正是来源于此。

sentences.en: Yes, we've both got so much to say about private practice, haven't we?
sentences.zh: 是啊，我们俩对私人执业都有很多话要说，不是吗？

sentences.en: We really have, we really have.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，真的有很多话要说。

sentences.en: So let's have a think just before we dive into that, just a little bit as a potted history really about your journey to becoming a clinical psychologist and to where you are now,
sentences.zh: 所以在我们深入探讨之前，先来简单回顾一下你成为临床心理学家的历程，以及你是如何走到今天这一步的，

sentences.en: if that's okay.
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, I kind of hope that some of the aspiring psychologists listen to this might find it reassuring to know that when I was 21 and I graduated with an English degree,
sentences.zh: 是啊，我真心希望那些有志成为心理学家的人听到这里能感到宽慰，因为我21岁拿到英语学位毕业时，

sentences.en: I didn't even know what a psychologist did or what one was, really.
sentences.zh: 我甚至根本不知道心理学家是做什么的，或者说，到底什么是心理学家。

sentences.en: I had a sort of vague interest in psychology and how people worked.
sentences.zh: 我对心理学以及人们的运作方式有一种模糊的兴趣。

sentences.en: But the reason I didn't study it at university was that I didn't think there were jobs in it.
sentences.zh: 但我当初没在大学里学这个，是因为我觉得这行没工作机会。

sentences.en: So I did English thinking I'd probably be a teacher or something like that, then realised that I really didn't want to be a teacher.
sentences.zh: 所以我选了英语专业，想着以后大概会当老师之类的，后来发现我其实根本不想当老师。

sentences.en: And so started working in a gym, mostly cleaning, doing a bit of fitness instruction, work, that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 于是我就开始在健身房工作，主要是打扫卫生，偶尔做点健身指导之类的工作。

sentences.en: And then because I am old, I saw an advert in the paper for a psych assistant job in the prison service.
sentences.zh: 后来因为我年纪大了，我在报纸上看到一则招聘启事，是监狱系统招心理助理的。

sentences.en: And I thought, oh, that'd be interesting getting to work in a prison and hear interesting stories that are different to mine.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，噢，去监狱工作应该挺有意思的，能听到一些和我完全不同的故事。

sentences.en: So I applied for it, not having a clue that psychology was this hyper-competitive world where everybody was like, you know,
sentences.zh: 于是我就申请了，完全不知道心理学这个领域竞争竟然如此激烈，每个人都在，你知道的，

sentences.en: trying to take the best steps to get on the clinical course and been dreaming of it since they were 12.
sentences.zh: 绞尽脑汁地规划每一步，只为能进入临床课程，甚至从12岁起就梦想着这一天。

sentences.en: And I had no idea of any of that.
sentences.zh: 而我对此一无所知。

sentences.en: I didn't know what CBT was.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道什么是认知行为疗法（CBT）。

sentences.en: I just literally chanced my arm and went for an interview.
sentences.zh: 我真的只是抱着试一试的心态去参加了面试。

sentences.en: And they gave me the job, I think, as an experiment to see what would happen if they had somebody entirely mouldable.
sentences.zh: 他们录用了我，我想，大概是想做个实验，看看如果招一个完全像白纸一样的人会发生什么。

sentences.en: And so I did that job in the prison service for about four years in total.
sentences.zh: 就这样，我在监狱系统里总共工作了大约四年。

sentences.en: And while I was there, I studied for an open university degree in psychology.
sentences.zh: 在那里工作期间，我修读了英国开放大学的心理学学位。

sentences.en: I absolutely loved it.
sentences.zh: 我真的非常热爱它。

sentences.en: I loved every minute of that job.
sentences.zh: 那份工作我每一分钟都乐在其中。

sentences.en: And I probably would have stayed there if it hadn't been for the fact that they changed the route to chartership.
sentences.zh: 如果不是因为他们改变了取得特许资格的途径，我大概会一直留在那儿。

sentences.en: So when I started in the prison service, it was the best employer in the whole wide world.
sentences.zh: 所以当我刚进监狱系统工作时，那可是全世界最好的雇主。

sentences.en: They would pay for your master's and take you right the way through to chartership without you ever having to take a break from paid employment.
sentences.zh: 他们会资助你读硕士，并一路支持你取得特许资格，期间你完全不需要中断带薪工作。

sentences.en: And that was something that it just didn't feel like an option to me.
sentences.zh: 而那对我来说，根本就不像是一个选项。

sentences.en: I think there's so much interesting stuff we could go into around that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得围绕这一点，我们有很多有趣的话题可以深入探讨。

sentences.en: But essentially, my parents are culturally working class, never found it acceptable, the idea of unpaid internships, that kind of thing for young people.
sentences.zh: 但从本质上讲，我的父母在文化上属于工人阶级，他们从不觉得无薪实习之类的事情对年轻人来说是可以接受的。

sentences.en: It was, you're an adult, you stand on your own two feet, you pay your way.
sentences.zh: 他们的观念是：你已经是成年人了，要自食其力，自己负担开销。

sentences.en: And so it never occurred to me to move back in with my parents or do any of those things, which I know now lots of people had to do to get onto clinical training.
sentences.zh: 所以我从未想过要搬回父母家住，或者做那些我后来才知道很多人为了进入临床培训不得不做的事情。

sentences.en: So I feel grateful that I managed to come through the route that I did, but that's why I was really attracted to the prison service, would have definitely stayed there.
sentences.zh: 所以我很庆幸自己能通过那条途径走过来，这也是我当初被监狱系统深深吸引的原因，我本来绝对会留在那里的。

sentences.en: But when they changed the rules and you then had to go away and study on your own for a master's, I thought, my God, £3,000 for a master's?
sentences.zh: 但当他们修改了规则，要求你必须离开岗位去自费攻读硕士时，我心想，天哪，读个硕士要三千英镑？

sentences.en: I'm not paying that, which I'm laughing because it's so tragic that young people have to pay so much more than that now.
sentences.zh: 我才不付这笔钱。我现在笑是因为想到现在的年轻人要付比这多得多的钱，真是太悲哀了。

sentences.en: But yes, so I, at that point, turned my attention to the NHS and the route into clinical training.
sentences.zh: 总之，就在那时，我将目光转向了英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）以及进入临床培训的途径。

sentences.en: And again, I knew nothing about it.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我对这方面一无所知。

sentences.en: I was really ignorant of the fact that it was really competitive and there were people kind of literally changing their whole lives to try and fit around this really narrow definition of what a clinical psychologist should look like.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的很无知，完全不知道这个领域竞争如此激烈，也不知道有些人为了符合临床心理学家那种极其狭隘的定义，简直是在彻底改变自己的人生。

sentences.en: Thank God, I didn't know any of that.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，我当时对此一无所知。

sentences.en: But what I did know was that my Open University qualification wasn't viewed in the same way that the red brick ones were.
sentences.zh: 但我确实知道，我的开放大学学历在别人眼里和那些红砖大学的学历是不一样的。

sentences.en: I'd heard that kind of on a grapevine from a friend.
sentences.zh: 我是从朋友那里听来的小道消息。

sentences.en: And so I applied to universities that did a test because I knew arrogantly that I would do well on a teSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我申请了那些有入学考试的大学，因为我自负地认为，我一定能考好。

sentences.en: And I did.
sentences.zh: 我确实做到了。

sentences.en: So that got me an interview at Salomon's.
sentences.zh: 所以这让我获得了萨洛蒙学院的面试机会。

sentences.en: And I guess the rest is history.
sentences.zh: 我想剩下的就是历史了。

sentences.en: But yeah,
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，

sentences.en: I just wanted to share that because I think it seems for a lot of young people that I talk to now that they feel like if they don't follow this very rigid pathway that involves a lot of honoree,
sentences.zh: 我只是想分享这一点，因为我觉得现在很多我交谈过的年轻人似乎觉得，如果他们不遵循那条非常死板的道路，涉及很多荣誉性的——

sentences.en: disgusting that they're called that, in my view, posts where you don't get paid and you get treated really badly, they think you have to jump through every hoop perfectly.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，被称为“荣誉”职位真是令人作呕，那些职位没有报酬，而且你受到的待遇非常糟糕——他们认为必须完美地跨越每一道障碍。

sentences.en: And I didn't, and I didn't even know about the hoops.
sentences.zh: 而我没有，我甚至都不知道还有这些障碍。

sentences.en: And I got there eventually.
sentences.zh: 但我最终还是成功了。

sentences.en: So I just wanted to kind of share that bit of the story.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想分享一下这段经历。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: That is so important.
sentences.zh: 这非常重要。

sentences.en: And I think you almost ended up as a forensic psychologist, really.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得你差点就成了法医心理学家，真的。

sentences.en: They would have been training you to be a forensic psychologist in the prison service, I would assume.
sentences.zh: 我想他们本会把你培养成监狱系统的法医心理学家。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: And I would have loved it.
sentences.zh: 而且我会很喜欢那份工作。

sentences.en: I love clinical, but I would have loved forensic as well.
sentences.zh: 我热爱临床心理学，但我也同样会热爱法医心理学。

sentences.en: I think it's fascinating.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它非常迷人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I too miss the job papers, because I think what I loved about the job papers is you didn't need to know search terms to search for.
sentences.zh: 我也很怀念以前的招聘报纸，因为我觉得招聘报纸最棒的地方在于，你不需要知道搜索关键词就能进行查找。

sentences.en: You could end up with something really interesting that really lit you up, but you wouldn't necessarily have searched for.
sentences.zh: 你可能会发现一些真正让你兴奋、让你眼前一亮的东西，而这些是你原本未必会去搜索的。

sentences.en: And I love that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这一点。

sentences.en: But it's interesting that you were employed as a psychology assistant, because actually, of course, what we know is if it was called an assistant psychologist,
sentences.zh: 但有趣的是，你当时是以心理学助理的身份受雇的，因为实际上，我们都知道，如果职位名称是“助理心理学家”，

sentences.en: you likely would have needed the BPS approved degree.
sentences.zh: 你很可能需要英国心理学会（BPS）认证的学位。

sentences.en: But often psychology assistant jobs don't quite have the same person spec and essential criteria.
sentences.zh: 但心理学助理的工作通常对个人规格和基本标准的要求并不完全相同。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it's really interesting, actually, because for that reason, they are not looked at in the same way on an application for clinical psychology,
sentences.zh: 而且这确实很有趣，因为正因如此，在申请临床心理学职位时，它们不会被同等看待，

sentences.en: which is another reason that people, you know, I don't think my application would have got through if I hadn't gone for a course that did a teSt.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么人们——你知道，我不认为如果我没有参加那个有测试的课程，我的申请能通过。

sentences.en: But the experience that I got there was so much richer than I think a lot of my colleagues that came through the assistant psychology route.
sentences.zh: 但我从那份工作中获得的经验，比我许多通过助理心理学家途径入行的同事要丰富得多。

sentences.en: So it really is about understanding what is relevant about the experience you've had.
sentences.zh: 所以关键在于理解你所拥有的经验中哪些是相关的。

sentences.en: Like I was doing PCLR interviews.
sentences.zh: 比如我当时在做PCLR（精神病态检查表）访谈。

sentences.en: I was doing a lot of cognitive testing, screening people for learning disabilities and just got really good at motivational interviewing,
sentences.zh: 我做了大量的认知测试，筛选学习障碍患者，并且在动机访谈方面变得非常擅长，

sentences.en: delivering CBT interventions, coaching as well.
sentences.zh: 还提供CBT（认知行为疗法）干预，以及辅导工作。

sentences.en: I did a lot of coaching in that role.
sentences.zh: 我在那个岗位上做了很多辅导工作。

sentences.en: And so what I think I was good at was extracting what I'd learned and seeing how it would map onto the competencies for a clinical psychologist,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我擅长的是提取我所学到的东西，并看看它如何与临床心理学家的胜任力要求相匹配，

sentences.en: which I just got off the BPS website.
sentences.zh: 这些要求我只是从BPS网站上找来的。

sentences.en: Whereas what I think a lot of people do is they have so much imposter syndrome that they don't see how they're maybe not quite perfect experience
sentences.zh: 而我认为很多人之所以做不到，是因为他们有太多的冒名顶替综合征，以至于他们看不到自己那些或许不够完美的经验，

sentences.en: might actually give them some of the competencies that they're looking for because they're so busy telling themselves it wasn't perfect.
sentences.zh: 其实可能已经具备了对方所寻找的一些胜任力，因为他们太忙于告诉自己这些经验并不完美。

sentences.en: Whereas I think something I had as a young person was just this ability to go, well, yeah, well,
sentences.zh: 而我认为我年轻时拥有一种能力，就是能够说，嗯，好吧，

sentences.en: I think that sort of maps across and to communicate that hopefully quite well at interview.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那类经验是可以通用的，并希望能在面试中很好地传达出来。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I think often you need more confidence in your experience than you might feel if you haven't come that traditional route.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我认为如果你没有走那条传统的道路，你往往需要比你感觉到的对自己经验更多的自信。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: I think from some of the kind of reading I've done into gender differences in job searches,
sentences.zh: 我想根据我读过的一些关于求职中性别差异的研究，

sentences.en: the data suggested men will have a tendency of applying for jobs where they fulfill 30% or whatever of the of the essential criteria,
sentences.zh: 数据表明，男性倾向于申请那些他们只满足30%左右基本标准的职位，

sentences.en: whereas women would only apply when they can fulfill 90%.
sentences.zh: 而女性往往只有在满足90%标准时才会申请。

sentences.en: And it feels like you've kind of taken a more holistic view, actually, than than many people would have done.
sentences.zh: 感觉你采取了一种比许多人更全面的视角，真的。

sentences.en: And and it worked, you know, because you got that job.
sentences.zh: 而且这奏效了，你知道，因为你得到了那份工作。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it was partly I think it would have been different, a different story if I'd really known how competitive it was.
sentences.zh: 而且部分原因是，我想如果我当时真的知道竞争有多激烈，情况就会完全不同了。

sentences.en: I'd never met a clinical psychologist when I went to Salomon.
sentences.zh: 我去萨洛蒙学院面试时，从未见过任何临床心理学家。

sentences.en: So there was nobody to tell me that it was really cutthroat and that people would have been applying for like 10 years.
sentences.zh: 所以没有人告诉我这个行业竞争非常残酷，人们可能已经申请了10年之久。

sentences.en: And when I got there and I saw those people and it was everything to them, you know, that shook me a bit.
sentences.zh: 当我到了那里，看到那些人，发现这份工作对他们来说就是一切时，你知道，这确实让我震惊了一下。

sentences.en: And I think if I'd met them before I'd done the interview, I probably wouldn't have gotten through it.
sentences.zh: 我想如果我在面试前就见过他们，我可能就无法通过面试了。

sentences.en: But I kind of sailed through with a bit of ignorance about all of that.
sentences.zh: 但我当时带着一点无知，算是顺利过关了。

sentences.en: And then it hit me like a sledgehammer on day one of training.
sentences.zh: 然后到了培训的第一天，现实就像大锤一样击中了我。

sentences.en: And I just thought I don't deserve to be here.
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，我不配待在这里。

sentences.en: And it was tricky after that point.
sentences.zh: 那之后的一段时间确实很棘手。

sentences.en: But thankfully, no one in my life knew that clinical psychology was a big deal.
sentences.zh: 但谢天谢地，我生活中的人没人觉得临床心理学是什么了不起的大事。

sentences.en: You know, my parents, my dad said to me, what, they'll pay you to do that?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的父母，我爸爸问我：“什么？他们还会付钱让你做那个？”

sentences.en: And I was like, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我说：“是的。”

sentences.en: So, yeah, nobody had really got in my head about it being a massive deal before I got there.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，在我去那里之前，没人给我灌输过这事儿有多么了不起。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, sometimes that helps.
sentences.zh: 是的，嗯，有时候这反而有帮助。

sentences.en: But yeah, I guess my next question was going to be, what was it like when you started training?
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我想我的下一个问题是，你刚开始培训时是什么感觉？

sentences.en: But it sounds like it was a very steep learning curve.
sentences.zh: 但听起来那是一个非常陡峭的学习曲线。

sentences.en: Oh, hugely, because the culture in the prison service could not be more different to the culture of clinical psychology.
sentences.zh: 哦，非常陡峭，因为监狱系统的文化与临床心理学的文化截然不同。

sentences.en: And, you know, we'll probably talk a bit today about the problems in the culture of clinical psychology.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们今天可能会谈谈临床心理学文化中的一些问题。

sentences.en: But, you know, neither of them are, you know, a perfect example of a healthy or useful culture by a long stretch.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，它们两者都远非健康或有用文化的完美典范。

sentences.en: But the culture in the prison service was very straight talking.
sentences.zh: 但监狱系统的文化非常直截了当。

sentences.en: They were very suspicious of people that used overly tentative and perhaps overly compassionate language.
sentences.zh: 他们非常怀疑那些使用过于委婉、或许过于富有同情心语言的人。

sentences.en: Whereas I landed in Salomons and picked up very quickly.
sentences.zh: 而我降落在萨洛蒙学院后，很快就领悟到了这一点。

sentences.en: I was like, oh, OK, we have to say I'm wondering a thousand times before we're allowed to make a point here.
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，哦，好吧，我们在这里表达观点之前，必须先说一千遍“我在想……”。

sentences.en: And I just couldn't believe the amount of circles that people talked in.
sentences.zh: 我简直无法相信人们说话时绕圈子的程度。

sentences.en: But I picked it up and I learned how to adapt to the to the new culture.
sentences.zh: 但我还是学会了，并学会了如何适应这种新文化。

sentences.en: And I see the benefits of both.
sentences.zh: 我看到了两者的优点。

sentences.en: You know, I never want to sound like I think one is better than the other.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我从不想让人觉得我认为其中一个比另一个更好。

sentences.en: I actually don't.
sentences.zh: 我其实并不这么认为。

sentences.en: I think in both streams of psychology, we need to find a middle ground.
sentences.zh: 我认为在心理学的两个流派中，我们都需要找到一个中间地带。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was a very steep learning curve.
sentences.zh: 是啊，那真是一个非常陡峭的学习曲线。

sentences.en: And I think also there was a lot of and we're going to talk loads about this today, I'm sure.
sentences.zh: 而且我想，我们今天肯定会对此进行大量的讨论。

sentences.en: But a lot of people felt kind of guilty to be there and like they were being paid loads for something that they didn't deserve to be paid loads for.
sentences.zh: 但很多人会因为身处其中而感到愧疚，觉得他们拿着高薪，却做着不值得拿高薪的工作。

sentences.en: And the prison service pays a lot less than the NHS in the lower level.
sentences.zh: 而且监狱系统在低层岗位上的薪水比国民医疗服务体系（NHS）要低得多。

sentences.en: So when I was a psychological assistant, we were actually being paid, I think, £14,000 a year.
sentences.zh: 所以当我做心理助理时，我们的年薪实际上只有1.4万英镑左右。

sentences.en: We then a couple of years in won a court case to get that raised up to about £17,000, I think.
sentences.zh: 后来过了几年，我们打赢了一场官司，把薪水提高到了大约1.7万英镑。

sentences.en: But it was very, very low paid.
sentences.zh: 但薪水依然非常、非常低。

sentences.en: And our NHS equivalents were always on a little bit more.
sentences.zh: 而我们在NHS的同僚薪水总是稍微高一点。

sentences.en: But I'd always seen the injustice in it.
sentences.zh: 但我一直都能看到其中的不公。

sentences.en: I'd always from day one been like, this is a low paid job considering what we're doing here.
sentences.zh: 从第一天起我就觉得，考虑到我们在这里所做的工作，这是一份低薪工作。

sentences.en: And in the prison service, it's really stark because you would have male colleagues with no qualifications coming in on day one,
sentences.zh: 在监狱系统中，这种对比非常鲜明，因为你会看到没有资质的男性同事第一天入职，

sentences.en: earning more than you in a job which was mostly sort of manual handling and not even people that had contact with prisoners.
sentences.zh: 赚的钱就比你多，而他们的工作大多是体力搬运，甚至不需要接触囚犯。

sentences.en: Whereas we would have unsupervised contact with prisoners as part of our role, which is, yeah, why we won that court case eventually.
sentences.zh: 而我们的角色需要与囚犯进行无监督接触，这也是我们最终打赢那场官司的原因。

sentences.en: But I'd never considered that we were overpaid, ever.
sentences.zh: 但我从来没觉得我们拿了高薪，一次都没有。

sentences.en: And I landed in clinical psychology training and everyone's talking about us being overpaid.
sentences.zh: 后来我进入了临床心理学培训，每个人都在谈论我们薪水过高。

sentences.en: And I couldn't, I really couldn't wrap my head around it, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我真的无法理解这一点。

sentences.en: And what there wasn't much recognition of was a reflection on why you would feel that way.
sentences.zh: 当时人们并没有意识到要去反思为什么会有这种感觉。

sentences.en: And I felt at the time, and I still feel that it came from trauma.
sentences.zh: 我当时觉得，现在也依然觉得，这源于创伤。

sentences.en: I felt these people have had their brains washed into believing that they're not worth anything.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这些人被洗脑了，让他们相信自己一文不值。

sentences.en: And I think that's, that comes from applying for a job that you're good for, you know, five times before they let you do it.
sentences.zh: 我认为这源于你申请一份你完全胜任的工作，却被拒绝了五次才被录用。

sentences.en: I don't think that's good for you psychologically.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这对你的心理健康有好处。

sentences.en: And I don't think going, you know, doing a difficult job and not being paid at all for it, as we do in the honorary psych jobs.
sentences.zh: 而且我不认为去做一份困难的工作却完全没有报酬，就像我们在荣誉心理学职位上所做的那样，

sentences.en: I don't think that that's good for you.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这对你有好处。

sentences.en: I think it leaves you with this idea that you're not worthy of having a comfortable life, you know, basically comfortable life, which I think is really sad.
sentences.zh: 我认为这会让你产生一种自己不配过上舒适生活的想法，你知道，基本上就是舒适的生活，我觉得这真的很可悲。

sentences.en: Totally agree.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: We've had a whole episode on the ethics of honorary assistant psychologist posts.
sentences.zh: 我们专门做过一期关于荣誉助理心理学家职位伦理的节目。

sentences.en: And yeah, like you say, like people begin to think, well, I can't apply for something qualified because I wouldn't, I'm not, I'm not doing good enough stuff here.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，人们开始想，好吧，我不能申请有资质的职位，因为我做得不够好。

sentences.en: It's actually, yes, you are, because actually they ought to have advertised that as a substantive post because they cannot run that therapy group without you.
sentences.zh: 其实不是的，你做得很好，因为他们本应该把那个职位作为正式岗位来招聘，因为没有你，他们根本无法开展那个治疗小组。

sentences.en: They can't do those, you know, those neuropsychs without you being the extra ratio of numbers.
sentences.zh: 没有你作为额外的人员比例，他们就无法进行那些神经心理学评估。

sentences.en: You are an essential part of the workforce, so it's not fair.
sentences.zh: 你是员工队伍中不可或缺的一部分，所以这不公平。

sentences.en: So please, if anyone's interested in that, please do check out the episode on honorary psychs.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果有人对此感兴趣，请务必去听听关于荣誉心理学家的那一期节目。

sentences.en: But so it sounds like you are really broadly experienced and naturally, of course, very reflective.
sentences.zh: 听起来你经验非常丰富，而且自然而然地，你也非常善于反思。

sentences.en: But you've honed your craft since kind of becoming closer to qualified and you've been qualified for some time now.
sentences.zh: 你在接近获得资质后磨练了自己的技能，而且你现在已经获得资质有一段时间了。

sentences.en: Do you think having that broad experience helped you to springboard into private practice, Rosie?
sentences.zh: Rosie，你认为那种广泛的经验是否帮助你跳板进入了私人执业领域？

sentences.en: Yes, it was never really my intention to go into private practice, which is interesting because I think I am quite entrepreneurial,
sentences.zh: 是的，我从未真正打算进入私人执业，这很有趣，因为我觉得自己很有创业精神，

sentences.en: but I didn't recognise that in myself as a younger person.
sentences.zh: 但我年轻时并没有意识到这一点。

sentences.en: Private practice became the only route available to me to continue being a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 私人执业成了我继续做心理学家的唯一途径。

sentences.en: My kids have additional needs.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子有特殊需求。

sentences.en: We're a military family.
sentences.zh: 我们是军人家庭。

sentences.en: And so with all the moving and lack of support network and the fact that my children couldn't really manage things like nursery,
sentences.zh: 所以，由于频繁搬家、缺乏支持网络，加上我的孩子们无法适应托儿所之类的地方，

sentences.en: it just wasn't possible for me to continue in the NHS.
sentences.zh: 我在NHS继续工作已经不可能了。

sentences.en: But we needed my income.
sentences.zh: 但我们需要我的收入。

sentences.en: And so I didn't want to work as anything else.
sentences.zh: 所以我不想从事其他任何工作。

sentences.en: You know, I really love psychology, much as I didn't have a long term game plan like a lot of people do.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我真的很热爱心理学，尽管我像很多人一样没有长期的职业规划。

sentences.en: When I arrived in it, I really felt it ticked all of my boxes.
sentences.zh: 当我进入这个领域时，我真的觉得它满足了我所有的要求。

sentences.en: I love the academic side.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢学术方面。

sentences.en: I love the applied bit.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢应用方面。

sentences.en: I love being in a room with people.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢和人们待在一个房间里。

sentences.en: I just love everything about it.
sentences.zh: 我就是喜欢关于它的一切。

sentences.en: So I was like, right, OK,
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想，好吧，

sentences.en: I'm going to have to find a way to be a psychologist that doesn't require me to be in an office far away from my home from like eight till four or nine till five every day.
sentences.zh: 我得找到一种做心理学家的方法，不需要每天从八点到四点或九点到五点待在离家很远的办公室里。

sentences.en: And so private practice was the only option for me, really.
sentences.zh: 所以私人执业对我来说确实是唯一的选择。

sentences.en: And I think it did help that I'd had a slightly different journey into private practice,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，我进入私人执业的旅程略有不同，这确实有所帮助，

sentences.en: because I suppose it meant that I've been used to thinking quite widely about how psychology can be used and looking for different opportunities to use my skills.
sentences.zh: 因为这意味着我习惯于广泛思考心理学的使用方式，并寻找不同的机会来运用我的技能。

sentences.en: But I also think clinical psychology training does give us that anyway.
sentences.zh: 但我也认为临床心理学培训本身就给了我们这种能力。

sentences.en: I think you have a broad training, which is really, really useful to you.
sentences.zh: 我认为你接受了广泛的培训，这对你非常、非常有帮助。

sentences.en: And sometimes I think we underestimate that.
sentences.zh: 有时我觉得我们低估了这一点。

sentences.en: I came out of training thinking like, oh, my God, I'm a jack of all trades and a master of none, like all of those imposter thoughts really came up.
sentences.zh: 我刚结束培训时心想，天哪，我什么都会一点，但什么都不精，那种冒名顶替综合征的想法真的出现了。

sentences.en: But actually, when you kind of find yourself with a client in private practice that has a complicated life history and you realise, gosh,
sentences.zh: 但实际上，当你在私人执业中遇到一个生活经历复杂的客户时，你会意识到，天哪，

sentences.en: you've mentioned something in this assessment session, which touches on my experience from every part of training.
sentences.zh: 你在评估环节提到的某些内容，触及了我培训中各个部分的经验。

sentences.en: Then you realise what an asset that is, because your formulations are that much richer for it.
sentences.zh: 那时你就会意识到这是一种多么宝贵的资产，因为你的案例构思会因此丰富得多。

sentences.en: But I did find and I still find that I use my forensic training all the time.
sentences.zh: 但我确实发现，而且现在依然发现，我一直在使用我的法医心理学培训。

sentences.en: It comes up in really unusual settings and it definitely springboarded my doctoral research, because in my time in the prison service, I must have done hundreds,
sentences.zh: 它出现在非常不寻常的环境中，而且它绝对为我的博士研究提供了跳板，因为在监狱系统工作期间，我一定做过数百次，

sentences.en: like way more than I'd ever be able to account of learning disability screenings.
sentences.zh: 多到数不清的学习障碍筛查。

sentences.en: And so when it came to learning how to do a full scale neurodevelopmental assessment, I was already confident with all that stuff, which is quite tricky,
sentences.zh: 所以当学习如何进行全面的神经发育评估时，我已经对所有这些内容充满信心，这其实相当棘手，

sentences.en: like reversing and block design, which goes against everything that I am naturally good at.
sentences.zh: 比如积木设计测试的倒置，这与我天生擅长的东西背道而驰。

sentences.en: And I didn't have to learn all of that at that point.
sentences.zh: 我当时不需要学习所有这些。

sentences.en: I just really was learning the nuance of interpretation.
sentences.zh: 我只是在学习解读的细微差别。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I think it it helped me immensely through training and then going into qualified work that I'd had that foundation, which was a bit broader.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我认为这种更广泛的基础在培训期间以及进入正式工作后对我帮助极大。

sentences.en: But weirdly, when I went into private practice, I was still a little bit narrow about it.
sentences.zh: 但奇怪的是，当我进入私人执业时，我的视野仍然有点狭窄。

sentences.en: And I'd really encourage anybody that's thinking about going to private practice to recognise that you can do any specialism independently.
sentences.zh: 我真的鼓励任何考虑进入私人执业的人认识到，你可以独立从事任何专业领域。

sentences.en: You have different methods of marketing and you have a different business model, but all of them are possible.
sentences.zh: 你有不同的营销方法和商业模式，但所有这些都是可能的。

sentences.en: Whereas when I went into independent practice, I didn't have like role models that I could ask.
sentences.zh: 而当我进入独立执业时，我没有可以请教的榜样。

sentences.en: I didn't really know anybody that had done it before me who wasn't like mega, super experienced.
sentences.zh: 我真的不认识任何在我之前做过这件事的人，除非是那些经验极其丰富的人。

sentences.en: And so clients just came to them because everybody in that area already knew who they were.
sentences.zh: 客户之所以找他们，是因为该地区的所有人都已经知道他们是谁了。

sentences.en: So there was nobody like me who had done it that I knew the story of.
sentences.zh: 所以没有像我这样的人，我不知道任何人的故事。

sentences.en: So I stepped away from my specialism in learning disability,
sentences.zh: 所以我离开了学习障碍这个专业领域，

sentences.en: which is what I was doing in my first qualified job and went into perinatal partially because I didn't know how learning disability work would work in private practice.
sentences.zh: 那是我第一份正式工作的内容，我转入了围产期心理学，部分原因是我不知道学习障碍工作在私人执业中该如何开展。

sentences.en: And also because I'd had a terrible personal experience of hyperemesis gravidarum in pregnancy and hadn't been able to find any psychological support.
sentences.zh: 也因为我在怀孕期间有过严重的妊娠剧吐经历，却找不到任何心理支持。

sentences.en: So I had, you know, I was passionate about it and I'm really glad that I did go that route.
sentences.zh: 所以我对此充满热情，我真的很高兴我选择了那条路。

sentences.en: But I'm also aware that I had more options available to me than I realised.
sentences.zh: 但我也意识到，我拥有的选择比我当时意识到的要多。

sentences.en: And I'd like anybody else, you know, thinking about their career and their private work to know you can do that.
sentences.zh: 我希望其他考虑职业生涯和私人工作的人知道，你可以做到这一点。

sentences.en: You can make any specialism work.
sentences.zh: 你可以让任何专业领域行得通。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: No, that's OK.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: I think I think what I've learned really from getting to know other private psychologists is many of us do start to really find our passion when we've had some similar life experience to that ourselves,
sentences.zh: 我认为我从结识其他私人心理学家那里真正学到的是，当我们自己有过类似的经历时，我们中的许多人确实开始真正找到自己的热情所在，

sentences.en: because you begin, like you say, to notice the gaps in that.
sentences.zh: 因为正如你所说，你开始注意到其中的差距。

sentences.en: So I started to begin to speak about grief when my dad died and my experience of kind of navigate the world with people being really, really rubbish at talking about grief.
sentences.zh: 所以我父亲去世时，我开始谈论悲伤，以及我经历的世界——人们在谈论悲伤时真的很糟糕。

sentences.en: And yeah, and obviously what we know from your experiences and then Dr. Cara Davey as well,
sentences.zh: 是的，显然我们从你的经历中了解到了这一点，还有Cara Davey博士的经历，

sentences.en: who unfortunately experienced the very sad sterile birth of her daughter and now really supports people in that as well.
sentences.zh: 她不幸经历了女儿死产的悲痛，现在也确实在支持这方面的人群。

sentences.en: And then, you know, I just think it really you don't have to be hit by a bus, as they say, to know it hurts, but it sure does help with your empathy.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，我只是觉得，正如人们所说，你不必被车撞了才知道疼，但这确实有助于你的同理心。

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我也这么认为。

sentences.en: And I think knowing what people actually need as well.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为了解人们真正需要什么也很重要。

sentences.en: And what I love about independent work is that you can see a gap in provision and design something that fills it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢独立工作的一点是，你可以发现服务中的空白，并设计出填补空白的东西。

sentences.en: And that's not always therapy.
sentences.zh: 那并不总是治疗。

sentences.en: Sometimes it is.
sentences.zh: 有时是。

sentences.en: And, you know, for hyperemesis, I know that there are very effective therapies that can really help people, but those are not routinely offered.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对于妊娠剧吐，我知道有一些非常有效的疗法可以真正帮助人们，但这些疗法并没有被常规提供。

sentences.en: In the NHS, it's not unheard of for even a perinatal psychologist to ask me what is hyperemesis gravidarum, which should be shocking.
sentences.zh: 在NHS，甚至有围产期心理学家问我什么是妊娠剧吐，这太令人震惊了。

sentences.en: It is really scary to me because it affects two to three percent of pregnancies.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说真的很可怕，因为它影响了百分之二到三的孕妇。

sentences.en: That's the lowest estimate.
sentences.zh: 这是最低的估计。

sentences.en: It could be as much as 10 percent.
sentences.zh: 可能高达百分之十。

sentences.en: And yet, you know, the knowledge is not really there that these people are in desperate need of support.
sentences.zh: 然而，人们并不真正了解这些人迫切需要支持。

sentences.en: I believe it's impossible to experience hyperemesis gravidarum, which for anybody that doesn't know, it's severe, completely intractable nausea and usually vomiting as well.
sentences.zh: 我相信经历妊娠剧吐是不可能的，对于不知道的人来说，这是一种严重的、完全无法缓解的恶心，通常还伴有呕吐。

sentences.en: That occurs, you know, outside of the typical window for nausea and vomiting in pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 它发生在怀孕期间典型的恶心和呕吐窗口期之外。

sentences.en: So I the way that I define it and I'd encourage anybody to define it is that if it's interfering with you living a good life, so you can't go to work, you can't socialize,
sentences.zh: 所以我定义它的方式，我也鼓励任何人这样定义，如果它干扰了你过上好生活，比如你不能去工作，不能社交，

sentences.en: you can't do the things that make your life worth living.
sentences.zh: 你不能做那些让你的生活值得过的事情。

sentences.en: Then it's HG.
sentences.zh: 那么这就是妊娠剧吐（HG）。

sentences.en: Get help for it, because normal nausea and vomiting in pregnancy, you should be able to live your life around it, whereas people with HG can't.
sentences.zh: 去寻求帮助，因为正常的孕期恶心和呕吐，你应该能够围绕它继续生活，而HG患者却不能。

sentences.en: It's like you lose all of those building blocks of good mental well-being.
sentences.zh: 就像你失去了所有良好心理健康的基石一样。

sentences.en: I think one of the most high profile cases was Princess Catherine, Duchess of Cambridge.
sentences.zh: 我想最引人注目的案例之一是凯瑟琳王妃，剑桥公爵夫人。

sentences.en: She had it with with George, I think, didn't she?
sentences.zh: 她怀乔治的时候有这种情况，对吧？

sentences.en: And so that kind of started more of a conversation.
sentences.zh: 所以这引发了更多的讨论。

sentences.en: And then it's maybe maybe hopefully stuck.
sentences.zh: 然后它可能，也许希望已经持续下去了。

sentences.en: Didn't didn't know.
sentences.zh: 不知道。

sentences.en: Yeah, it did.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: And it didn't.
sentences.zh: 但也没有。

sentences.en: So it did.
sentences.zh: 所以确实如此。

sentences.en: But obviously she accesses private health care and will have received treatment extremely promptly.
sentences.zh: 但显然她获得了私人医疗保健，并且会非常及时地得到治疗。

sentences.en: And it's like a weird chicken and egg scenario.
sentences.zh: 这就像一个奇怪的先有鸡还是先有蛋的情况。

sentences.en: So I speak to many people in my clinic that say, oh, well, mine wasn't.
sentences.zh: 所以我诊所里的许多人说，哦，好吧，我的情况不是。

sentences.en: Maybe mine wasn't HG because I never had a drip.
sentences.zh: 也许我的不是HG，因为我从来没有挂过吊瓶。

sentences.en: I never had, you know, vitamin injections or any of the stuff that Princess Catherine had.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有接受过凯瑟琳王妃那样的维生素注射或任何治疗。

sentences.en: So mine must have not been as bad.
sentences.zh: 所以我的情况一定没那么严重。

sentences.en: No, I'm afraid care in this country is just really poor for HG.
sentences.zh: 不，恐怕这个国家的HG护理真的很差。

sentences.en: I've just recorded an episode of my podcast, Pregnant and Sick, with a doctor who specializes in hyperemesis.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚录制了一期我的播客《怀孕且生病》，采访了一位专门研究妊娠剧吐的医生。

sentences.en: And we don't get the help that we need here.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里得不到我们需要的帮助。

sentences.en: We don't get the drugs that we need.
sentences.zh: 我们得不到我们需要的药物。

sentences.en: We don't get the nutrition that we need.
sentences.zh: 我们得不到我们需要的营养。

sentences.en: We don't get IV drip when we need it.
sentences.zh: 我们需要时得不到静脉输液。

sentences.en: And that means that we have much worse outcomes.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们的预后要差得多。

sentences.en: So people are using the fact that they didn't get help to tell themselves that their condition was not severe.
sentences.zh: 所以人们利用自己没有得到帮助的事实来告诉自己，他们的病情并不严重。

sentences.en: When actually, unfortunately, you can have very severe HG in this country and not receive any help for it unless you know what to ask for.
sentences.zh: 而实际上，不幸的是，在这个国家，你可能患有非常严重的HG，却得不到任何帮助，除非你知道该要求什么。

sentences.en: So a lot of what I do on Substack is talk about what you can ask for and what you should be advocating for and the reasons that it can help you as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我大部分在Substack上做的事情就是谈论你可以要求什么，你应该争取什么，以及它能如何帮助你。

sentences.en: So, you know, obviously, on the psychological side, we've got all the stuff from the acceptance and commitment therapy literature,
sentences.zh: 所以，显然，在心理方面，我们有来自接纳承诺疗法（ACT）文献的所有内容，

sentences.en: which is really helpful for managing symptoms and helping you to get through it psychologically.
sentences.zh: 这对管理症状和帮助你从心理上度过难关非常有帮助。

sentences.en: We can also see that EMDR is quite helpful for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 我们还可以看到EMDR（眼动脱敏再加工疗法）对很多人很有帮助。

sentences.en: And I use that a lot in my clinic and really, really helpful for managing the trauma, but also for breaking some of those associations that make you just vomit all the time.
sentences.zh: 我在诊所里经常使用它，它对管理创伤非常有帮助，也能打破那些让你一直呕吐的联想。

sentences.en: So that can be really useful.
sentences.zh: 所以这非常有用。

sentences.en: But also there's a ton of medications, loads of medical options that are safe that you can ask for and try and they don't normally get offered to people.
sentences.zh: 而且还有大量的药物，很多安全的医疗选择你可以要求尝试，但通常不会主动提供给人们。

sentences.en: And nutritional support should be available way before it is to most people.
sentences.zh: 营养支持应该在大多数人得到它之前就提供。

sentences.en: But again, if you ask, there are specialist services you can be referred to.
sentences.zh: 但同样，如果你要求，有专门的服务可以转诊。

sentences.en: So always ask.
sentences.zh: 所以一定要问。

sentences.en: But anyway, as you can tell, Marianne, it absolutely drove me bonkers that this information wasn't out there for people.
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，Marianne，正如你所看到的，这些信息没有向人们公开，这绝对让我抓狂。

sentences.en: And that there weren't social media accounts giving people this information that, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且没有社交媒体账号向人们提供这些信息，你知道，

sentences.en: people go through this and they don't even look for therapy because they don't know that it can help them.
sentences.zh: 人们经历这些，甚至不去寻找治疗，因为他们不知道治疗可以帮助他们。

sentences.en: So I set out early doors to shout about hyperemesis gravidarum and the fact that therapy helps from, you know, day one of my independent practice.
sentences.zh: 所以我很早就开始大声疾呼妊娠剧吐，以及治疗有帮助的事实，从我独立执业的第一天起就是这样。

sentences.en: And I'm still shouting about it a lot now.
sentences.zh: 我现在还在大声疾呼。

sentences.en: And I do feel we're getting somewhere.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们正在取得进展。

sentences.en: There's an amazing charity, Pregnancy Sickness Support, who have put some really good stuff out there and it's making a bit of a splash.
sentences.zh: 有一个很棒的慈善机构叫“妊娠疾病支持”（Pregnancy Sickness Support），他们发布了一些非常好的内容，正在引起不小的反响。

sentences.en: But to come back to, you know, why is independent work so important?
sentences.zh: 但回到刚才的话题，你知道，为什么独立执业如此重要？

sentences.en: It's for this reason, because if you're not commissioned to talk about hyperemesis gravidarum in the NHS, you can't do it.
sentences.zh: 原因就在于，如果你没有获得英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）的委托去谈论妊娠剧吐，你就无法开展相关工作。

sentences.en: And if they haven't yet recognised that this is a problem, you can't research it.
sentences.zh: 如果他们还没有意识到这是一个问题，你就无法进行研究。

sentences.en: You can't see patients for it.
sentences.zh: 你无法为此接诊患者。

sentences.en: You can't do anything with it.
sentences.zh: 你对此什么也做不了。

sentences.en: You can't put your opinions out publicly about it.
sentences.zh: 你无法公开表达关于此事的观点。

sentences.en: Whereas because I'm independent, I'm working on research in this area.
sentences.zh: 而因为我是独立执业，我正在这一领域进行研究。

sentences.en: I'm writing on this area.
sentences.zh: 我正在撰写关于这一领域的文章。

sentences.en: I'm on social media.
sentences.zh: 我在社交媒体上活跃。

sentences.en: I'm on Substack.
sentences.zh: 我在 Substack 上写作。

sentences.en: And I'm seeing clients for this condition.
sentences.zh: 而且我正在为患有这种疾病的客户提供咨询。

sentences.en: And I don't I don't know, but I don't think I'd be able to see most of the people that come to me if I was working in a perinatal service,
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么说，但我认为如果我还在围产期服务部门工作，我可能无法接诊大多数来找我的人，

sentences.en: because they are so overwhelmed with the people that more easily meet their criteria.
sentences.zh: 因为他们已经被那些更容易符合服务标准的人群挤满了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's a bit of a rant, but I do love working independently because you get to pursue your interests.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这听起来有点像是在发牢骚，但我确实热爱独立执业，因为你可以追求自己感兴趣的事物。

sentences.en: And you didn't just start a private practice.
sentences.zh: 而且你不仅仅是开了个私人诊所。

sentences.en: You decided you were going to help support others to start their private practice as well.
sentences.zh: 你还决定去支持其他人也开启他们的私人执业之路。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of shame out there, isn't there?
sentences.zh: 外界其实有很多羞耻感，不是吗？

sentences.en: About should I?
sentences.zh: 关于我该不该做？

sentences.en: Shouldn't I?
sentences.zh: 我应不应该做？

sentences.en: What would other people say?
sentences.zh: 别人会怎么说？

sentences.en: You know, what does it say about me if I've been trained by the NHS to then leave?
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果我接受了 NHS 的培训却选择离开，这说明了什么？

sentences.en: There's a load of hurdles to overcome before we even begin to see our first client in private practice, isn't there?
sentences.zh: 在我们开始在私人执业中接诊第一位客户之前，有很多障碍需要克服，对吧？

sentences.en: Oh, 100 percent.
sentences.zh: 哦，百分之百是这样。

sentences.en: And, you know, as I've already mentioned, I didn't have a very much choice about it.
sentences.zh: 而且，如我之前所提，我对此其实没得选。

sentences.en: So I really I felt the weight of that shame.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的，我感受到了那种羞耻感的重压。

sentences.en: I, you know, I really struggled.
sentences.zh: 我，你知道，我真的挣扎过。

sentences.en: I didn't want to go into private practice at Salomons where I trained.
sentences.zh: 在接受培训的 Salomons 机构时，我并不想进入私人执业领域。

sentences.en: The discourse around private practice was extremely negative.
sentences.zh: 当时关于私人执业的舆论极其负面。

sentences.en: I hadn't imagined it for myself until maybe I was like in my late 50s or something.
sentences.zh: 我从未想过自己会从事这一行，直到我大概快 50 多岁的时候。

sentences.en: I think I'd had a little vision that I might retire into private practice at some stage.
sentences.zh: 我想我曾有过一个小小的愿景，也许在某个阶段退休后可以进入私人执业。

sentences.en: And but it hadn't been part of the game plan for me.
sentences.zh: 但那并不是我人生规划的一部分。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, I had all of the big feelings.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我当时内心充满了各种复杂的情绪。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, my children needed something.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，我的孩子们需要一些东西。

sentences.en: And so I fought through the big feelings and made it happen.
sentences.zh: 所以我克服了那些强烈的情绪，并让它成为了现实。

sentences.en: And it was extremely painful.
sentences.zh: 那过程极其痛苦。

sentences.en: I mean, I literally had an upset stomach every day for a year.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我整整一年每天都感到胃部不适。

sentences.en: I felt so ill about it for that whole year.
sentences.zh: 那一整年我对此都感到非常难受。

sentences.en: I don't people often ask me, like how I'm so confident or how how I find it so easy to do business and marketing.
sentences.zh: 人们经常问我，为什么我如此自信，或者为什么我觉得做生意和市场营销如此简单。

sentences.en: I did not find it like that in the first year at all.
sentences.zh: 我在第一年完全没有这种感觉。

sentences.en: But what happened for me and I believe what happened to most people is you start to help people and you start to help people that weren't getting help from the NHS.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，以及我相信对大多数人来说，发生的事情是：你开始帮助他人，而且你开始帮助那些在 NHS 无法获得帮助的人。

sentences.en: And sadly, that's an awful lot of people who, you know, you imagine when you're working in the NHS,
sentences.zh: 可悲的是，有太多这样的人，你知道，当你还在 NHS 工作时，你会想象，

sentences.en: you imagine the people using private services are all mega privileged and they don't really need very much.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得使用私人服务的人都是超级富有且并不真正需要太多帮助的人。

sentences.en: That is not the case.
sentences.zh: 事实并非如此。

sentences.en: I found there were just huge sections of society that weren't meeting criteria for one reason or another and were being refused a service.
sentences.zh: 我发现社会上有很大一部分人因为各种原因不符合服务标准，而被拒绝提供服务。

sentences.en: And so I've, you know, I've never felt guilty really since that first year because I can see the work that I'm doing that, you know, nobody, these people can't get any other way.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，自第一年之后我就再也没有感到内疚了，因为我能看到我所做的工作，你知道，这些人通过其他任何途径都无法获得帮助。

sentences.en: I've also found there are loads of different business models and loads of ways of giving back to people that can't afford your full fee.
sentences.zh: 我还发现有很多不同的商业模式，也有很多方式可以回馈那些负担不起你全额费用的客户。

sentences.en: So I talk a lot in psychology business school about, you know, never discounting your fees.
sentences.zh: 所以在心理学商学院（Psychology Business School），我经常谈论，你知道，永远不要打折你的费用。

sentences.en: You work out what your fee needs to be and you charge that fee because otherwise you're going to end up working for less than you did in the NHS very quickly.
sentences.zh: 你要计算出你的费用应该是多少，并收取这个费用，否则你很快就会发现自己的收入比在 NHS 时还要低。

sentences.en: You know, if you've never worked privately, you won't believe me, but you just have to trust me on this one.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你从未从事过私人执业，你可能不会相信我，但在这件事上你必须相信我。

sentences.en: I've supported hundreds of people through this process and you can very easily end up on minimum wage quickly if you start discounting your services.
sentences.zh: 我已经支持了数百人完成了这个过程，如果你开始对服务打折，你很快就会陷入最低工资的境地。

sentences.en: So you leave that fee where it needs to be and then you get creative about the other ways that you can give back.
sentences.zh: 所以，保持你的收费标准，然后发挥创意，寻找其他回馈社会的方式。

sentences.en: So the simplest way is you offer some pro bono hours through a charity.
sentences.zh: 最简单的方法就是通过慈善机构提供一些公益时数。

sentences.en: I've done that from very early on in my practice, but you can do other things like you can work on research.
sentences.zh: 我在执业初期就开始这样做了，但你也可以做其他事情，比如参与研究。

sentences.en: It doesn't necessarily have funding behind it yet.
sentences.zh: 它可能暂时还没有资金支持。

sentences.en: You can join in with projects that local community interest companies are running.
sentences.zh: 你可以加入当地社区利益公司（CIC）正在开展的项目。

sentences.en: You can provide supervision that people can't afford to pay for for their charity or their CIC.
sentences.zh: 你可以为那些负担不起费用的慈善机构或 CIC 提供督导服务。

sentences.en: You can set up your own CIC.
sentences.zh: 你可以创办自己的 CIC。

sentences.en: I ran one for a few years alongside my private practice.
sentences.zh: 我在私人执业的同时，也运营过一家这样的机构几年。

sentences.en: And so there's tons of things that you can do to give back and provide something again that is not being provided.
sentences.zh: 所以，有很多事情你可以做，既能回馈社会，又能提供那些目前尚未被提供的服务。

sentences.en: And that independence allows you to be really creative about how you do that.
sentences.zh: 而这种独立性让你在如何实现这一点上非常有创造力。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think the guilt and the shame kind of lifted when I discovered all those different ways of working.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想当我发现所有这些不同的工作方式时，那种内疚感和羞耻感就消散了。

sentences.en: And I realized that I was making a really positive impact in people's lives, but it was very big for me at the beginning.
sentences.zh: 我意识到我正在对他人的生活产生非常积极的影响，但这对我来说起初意义重大。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, I don't want people to think that it's just a mindset that you can switch on and off.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我不希望人们认为这只是一种可以随意开关的心态。

sentences.en: I don't think it is for a lot of us.
sentences.zh: 我认为对我们许多人来说并非如此。

sentences.en: You have to get out there and start doing it.
sentences.zh: 你必须走出去，开始行动。

sentences.en: And then your feelings will start changing as a result of your actions rather than, you know, for me anyway.
sentences.zh: 然后你的感受会随着你的行动而改变，而不是——至少对我来说是这样。

sentences.en: I couldn't do it as a thought experiment, really.
sentences.zh: 我真的无法仅通过思维实验来做到这一点。

sentences.en: But, yeah, so you asked why I set up Psychology Business School to support other people.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，你问我为什么要创办心理学商学院来支持其他人。

sentences.en: And that was because two years into my practice, I'd found my feet with it.
sentences.zh: 那是因为在执业两年后，我已经站稳了脚跟。

sentences.en: I wasn't feeling sick anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不再感到恶心了。

sentences.en: I'd found these other business models which had made my income a lot more stable.
sentences.zh: 我已经找到了这些让我的收入更加稳定的商业模式。

sentences.en: I'd kind of worked my way through a lot of that shame and a lot of those probleMs.
sentences.zh: 我已经克服了大部分的羞耻感和那些问题。

sentences.en: And I looked around me and there really wasn't anybody teaching about private practice out there.
sentences.zh: 我环顾四周，发现真的没有人教授关于私人执业的知识。

sentences.en: There was one good book that I found, the Rob Ball book, and that had been really helpful to me.
sentences.zh: 我找到了一本好书，就是 Rob Ball 的那本，它对我非常有帮助。

sentences.en: But I'd spent hours at the beginning Googling how do I set up a psychology private practice?
sentences.zh: 但在起初，我花了好几个小时在谷歌上搜索：我该如何建立一个心理学私人诊所？

sentences.en: How do I do a good private practice?
sentences.zh: 我该如何做好私人执业？

sentences.en: I'm a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是一名临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Like all those things I put into Google had never returned any UK based results.
sentences.zh: 我输入谷歌的所有这些搜索词，从来没有得到过任何英国本土的结果。

sentences.en: And I didn't find the US results very helpful because it's such a different system over there.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得美国的结果对我帮助不大，因为那边的系统完全不同。

sentences.en: And so when I started to kind of feel a bit more confident and I met a couple of other psychologists in Plymouth
sentences.zh: 所以当我开始感到更有信心，并且在普利茅斯遇到了另外几位心理学家时，

sentences.en: who were really supportive of me and made me feel a bit more confident about myself,
sentences.zh: 他们非常支持我，让我对自己更有信心，

sentences.en: I thought, well, let's put a podcast together where I get people that have done well in private practice to come on
sentences.zh: 我想，好吧，让我们做一个播客，邀请那些在私人执业中做得很好的人来，

sentences.en: and talk to me about the exciting stuff they do and just get some positive narratives out there.
sentences.zh: 和我谈谈他们所做的令人兴奋的事情，并传播一些积极的叙事。

sentences.en: That private practice can be inspiring and exciting and it doesn't have to be shameful.
sentences.zh: 私人执业可以是鼓舞人心和令人兴奋的，它不必是令人羞耻的。

sentences.en: And then we can infuse that with some tips and tricks for people as well.
sentences.zh: 然后我们也可以为人们注入一些技巧和窍门。

sentences.en: So they at least know how to get their foundation sorted and just feel a bit less alone with it.
sentences.zh: 这样他们至少知道如何打好基础，并且在这一过程中感到不那么孤单。

sentences.en: So that was the intention of the Business of Psychology podcast, which is still going now, I'm proud to say.
sentences.zh: 这就是《心理学商业》（Business of Psychology）播客的初衷，我很自豪地说，它至今仍在运行。

sentences.en: But very quickly, people started to ask me for specific stuff.
sentences.zh: 但很快，人们开始向我询问具体的问题。

sentences.en: And so I'd get experts in to do a masterclass on things like, should I be a limited company?
sentences.zh: 所以我请专家来做大师课，主题比如：我应该注册为有限公司吗？

sentences.en: And those kinds of common questions that come up at the beginning.
sentences.zh: 以及那些在起步阶段经常出现的常见问题。

sentences.en: And yeah, before I knew it, really, that had spiraled into a course and then coaching.
sentences.zh: 是的，在我意识到之前，它真的已经演变成了一门课程，然后是教练辅导。

sentences.en: And yeah, it's just gone from there, really.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，它就从那里发展起来了。

sentences.en: And I love it.
sentences.zh: 我热爱它。

sentences.en: I love any part I can play in getting more independent work out there so that we can start evidencing the gaps that exist in public sector.
sentences.zh: 我热爱我所能扮演的任何角色，去推动更多的独立工作，这样我们就可以开始证明公共部门中存在的差距。

sentences.en: I yeah, I'm so excited about that.
sentences.zh: 我，是的，我对此感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: I love every one of my coaching clients inspires me.
sentences.zh: 我热爱我的每一位教练辅导客户，他们激励着我。

sentences.en: And every single one of them is meeting a need that the public sector doesn't meet.
sentences.zh: 他们中的每一个都在满足公共部门无法满足的需求。

sentences.en: And if we all collect our evidence, we can show what needs are not being met and advocate for those people to the public sector.
sentences.zh: 如果我们都收集证据，我们就能展示出哪些需求未被满足，并为这些人向公共部门进行倡导。

sentences.en: And ultimately, that is my goal.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这就是我的目标。

sentences.en: Oh, that is so powerful.
sentences.zh: 哦，那太有力量了。

sentences.en: And yeah, that's your that's your why.
sentences.zh: 是的，这就是你的——这就是你的“为什么”。

sentences.en: But it sounds like we're kind of quite similar in that we like we like to spread our our time over a kind of variety of things in the week and across the month.
sentences.zh: 但听起来我们很相似，我们都喜欢在每周和每月的时间里，把精力分散在各种不同的事情上。

sentences.en: Yeah, it sounds like you were two podcasts on the go.
sentences.zh: 是的，听起来你同时在做两个播客。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Is that what?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Well, hats off to you.
sentences.zh: 好吧，向你致敬。

sentences.en: One is a lot to manage, I find.
sentences.zh: 我发现管理一个播客就已经很多了。

sentences.en: So pregnant and sick is a bit different.
sentences.zh: 所以《怀孕与生病》（Pregnant and Sick）有点不同。

sentences.en: So I set that up a couple of years ago.
sentences.zh: 我是在几年前创办它的。

sentences.en: And I use it basically as a like resource for people who are going through hyperemesis or trying to recover from it.
sentences.zh: 我基本上把它当作一个资源库，供那些正在经历妊娠剧吐或试图从中恢复的人使用。

sentences.en: And so it's not like I'm trying to do an episode every week.
sentences.zh: 所以这不像是我试图每周做一期节目。

sentences.en: I when I have an idea of, OK, this exercise worked really well with the last client I worked with.
sentences.zh: 当我有一个想法时，比如：好的，这个练习在我上一位客户身上效果很好。

sentences.en: Or, you know, I met this person that shared a perspective that would have helped me so much while I was going through it.
sentences.zh: 或者，你知道，我遇到了这个人，他分享了一个观点，如果我在经历那段时期时能听到，对我会有很大帮助。

sentences.en: Then I'll put an episode out.
sentences.zh: 那么我就会发布一期节目。

sentences.en: But it kind of sits on my sub stack.
sentences.zh: 它基本上就放在我的 Substack 上。

sentences.en: It's there for people that need it.
sentences.zh: 它是为那些需要它的人准备的。

sentences.en: It's not designed as a like week in week out podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 它不是被设计成那种每周更新的播客。

sentences.en: I couldn't manage that at all.
sentences.zh: 我根本无法应付那种频率。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢它。

sentences.en: OK, so it sounds like it's almost like a spoken blog almoSt.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以听起来它几乎就像一个有声博客。

sentences.en: So things when it comes to you, when the strikes inspiration, that's when you that's when you record.
sentences.zh: 所以当灵感来临时，那就是你录制的时候。

sentences.en: People will just hit subscribe, hit follow and it will ping into them when it's there.
sentences.zh: 人们只需点击订阅、点击关注，当有新内容时，它就会推送到他们那里。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And I recommend it to people.
sentences.zh: 而且我会把它推荐给人们。

sentences.en: So if I it's another way of working with people that can't necessarily afford therapy with me, if I get an inquiry and they can't afford the therapy,
sentences.zh: 如果我——这是与那些负担不起我治疗费用的客户合作的另一种方式，如果我收到咨询，而他们负担不起治疗费用，

sentences.en: but I know that they need psychological help for HG.
sentences.zh: 但我知道他们需要针对妊娠剧吐的心理帮助。

sentences.en: Then I know, OK, I've got like I can't remember how many episodes is now, like six or eight, which give you most of the psychoeducation I would give you in therapy.
sentences.zh: 那么我知道，好的，我已经有了——我不记得现在有多少期了，大概六到八期，它们提供了我会在治疗中给你的大部分心理教育。

sentences.en: It's not the same as the relationship, obviously, but it's got that information about how you advocate for yourself.
sentences.zh: 当然，这和治疗关系不一样，但它包含了关于你如何为自己争取权益的信息。

sentences.en: It's got some mindfulness based exercises that people find really helpful and crucially.
sentences.zh: 它包含了一些人们觉得非常有帮助的正念练习，而且至关重要的是，

sentences.en: It kind of helps people understand that their mind plays a role.
sentences.zh: 它能帮助人们理解他们的心理确实起了一定作用。

sentences.en: It's not the cause of HG, but it can make it a lot worse.
sentences.zh: 它不是妊娠剧吐的原因，但它会让情况变得更糟。

sentences.en: So for me, it's really important that everybody's empowered with that knowledge and it's there for them whenever they need it.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，让每个人都掌握这些知识非常重要，而且无论何时他们需要，这些资源都在那里。

sentences.en: So I love that and I love Substack as a platform because it allows me to do that, but kind of bracket it off.
sentences.zh: 所以我喜欢这一点，我也喜欢 Substack 这个平台，因为它允许我这样做，并将其归类整理。

sentences.en: And then in the rest of my Substack, I talk about, you know, parenting children with additional needs and, you know,
sentences.zh: 在我的 Substack 的其余部分，我谈论的是，你知道，抚养有特殊需求的孩子，以及，你知道，

sentences.en: running a business around that and lots of much broader issues that touch a lot of people that I work with.
sentences.zh: 围绕这些开展业务，还有许多与我合作的许多人息息相关的更广泛的问题。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I think it's worth thinking about the people that we surround ourselves with.
sentences.zh: 我认为值得思考一下我们周围的人。

sentences.en: So there's a there's a Facebook group that you and I are both part of, which accepts qualified practitioner psychologists in private practice.
sentences.zh: 有一个你我都加入的 Facebook 群组，它接受在私人执业中具有资质的心理学家。

sentences.en: And I was part of that Facebook group for I kind of watched for a while before I probably for a couple of years, really.
sentences.zh: 我加入那个 Facebook 群组已经——我在加入之前观察了一段时间，可能观察了几年，真的。

sentences.en: And then it's funny that I've already mentioned Dr. Cara, because it was really down to Dr. Cara and my husband that I started a a business.
sentences.zh: 而且很有趣的是，我已经提到了 Cara 博士，因为确实多亏了 Cara 博士和我丈夫，我才开始创业。

sentences.en: You know, I can now say it's a business.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我现在可以说这是一个生意了。

sentences.en: At the time, I was a bit embarrassed and ashamed to call myself a businesswoman, but that is where I am now.
sentences.zh: 当时，我还有点尴尬和羞于称自己为女商人，但这就是我现在所处的位置。

sentences.en: But Cara was always like, come on, do it like you're going to find it not it's going to be easier than you think it is.
sentences.zh: 但 Cara 总说，来吧，做吧，你会发现这并不——它会比你想象的要容易。

sentences.en: Like you would be brilliant to this.
sentences.zh: 就像你做这个会非常出色一样。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, no, I'm not enough.
sentences.zh: 而我当时想，哦，不，我不够好。

sentences.en: I'm not enough.
sentences.zh: 我不够好。

sentences.en: I'm not enough.
sentences.zh: 我不够好。

sentences.en: I'm not enough.
sentences.zh: 我不够好。

sentences.en: And then my youngest was starting preschool and I was in the NHS three days a week.
sentences.zh: 然后我最小的孩子开始上学前班，而我在 NHS 每周工作三天。

sentences.en: So I was going to have two mornings off a week when he was in preschool.
sentences.zh: 所以我每周会有两个上午的空闲时间，当他在学前班的时候。

sentences.en: And my husband was like, well, what are you going to do with your time then?
sentences.zh: 我丈夫当时就问，那你打算怎么利用这段时间呢？

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, clean the house, have a massage, have a nap.
sentences.zh: 我说，哦，打扫卫生、做个按摩、睡个午觉。

sentences.en: Like and he was like, I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 他当时就说，我觉得不行。

sentences.en: You could start you could start your private practice.
sentences.zh: 你可以开始，你可以开始你的私人执业了。

sentences.en: You could start that business.
sentences.zh: 你可以开始做那个生意了。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, I suppose I could, but I probably preferred my ideas.
sentences.zh: 我说，哦，我想我确实可以，但我可能更喜欢我自己的想法。

sentences.en: But it was it was those two spare, spare, spare mornings a week that was the start of my private practice.
sentences.zh: 但正是每周那两个空闲的早晨，开启了我的私人执业之路。

sentences.en: And interestingly, on the first ever morning when I was going off to clinic, I was standing at my kitchen sink crying.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，在第一次去诊所的那个早晨，我站在厨房水槽前哭了。

sentences.en: And that probably doesn't surprise you because of the amount of people that you've coached through this.
sentences.zh: 考虑到你辅导过那么多经历过这一过程的人，这可能让你并不感到惊讶。

sentences.en: But I was like feeling I'm not enough.
sentences.zh: 但我当时感觉自己不够好。

sentences.en: I'm going to not know the answers.
sentences.zh: 我担心自己不知道答案。

sentences.en: I'm going to be not not good enough.
sentences.zh: 我担心自己不够优秀。

sentences.en: I'm not worth the money that I'm going to be paid for this because because I was so used to being paid such a lower wage in the NHS comparatively hour by hour.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己不值这个价，因为我太习惯在国民保健署（NHS）按小时计算的低薪工作了。

sentences.en: And so I just had this massive sense of just that imposter syndrome not being enough.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时有一种强烈的冒名顶替综合征，觉得自己不够好。

sentences.en: And, you know, I managed to pull myself together and get to through my first clinic, which was two people.
sentences.zh: 不过，我还是设法调整好状态，完成了第一次诊疗，接待了两位病人。

sentences.en: And then I had to race back and get my youngest from school.
sentences.zh: 然后我得赶紧赶回去，从学校接我最小的孩子。

sentences.en: But it was so much less than I'd been used to working in the NHS, actually.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，这比我在NHS工作时要轻松多了。

sentences.en: That doesn't I don't mean to sound that dismissive of the work I was doing.
sentences.zh: 我并不是想贬低我当时所做的工作。

sentences.en: But, you know, they wouldn't have met the criteria for the NHS, but they were still suffering.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，他们可能不符合NHS的接收标准，但他们依然在受苦。

sentences.en: They were still distressed.
sentences.zh: 他们依然感到痛苦。

sentences.en: And the skills I needed came to me readily.
sentences.zh: 我所需的技能很自然地就发挥出来了。

sentences.en: And I did a good job and I was really surprised.
sentences.zh: 我做得很好，这让我非常惊讶。

sentences.en: Yeah, I recognize that feeling when I first got positive feedback from somebody in private practice.
sentences.zh: 是的，我明白那种感觉，当我第一次从私人执业的病人那里得到积极反馈时。

sentences.en: I was literally blindsided by it.
sentences.zh: 我简直被惊到了。

sentences.en: I was like, what?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，什么？

sentences.en: I did well.
sentences.zh: 我做得很好。

sentences.en: But, you know, I think that's part of what our training does to us.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，我认为这是我们所受训练对我们影响的一部分。

sentences.en: I think it really does make you think less of your skills.
sentences.zh: 我认为它确实让你低估了自己的技能。

sentences.en: I think there's a prevailing culture that everything we know is just common sense and we don't really know anything.
sentences.zh: 我认为存在一种普遍的文化，认为我们所知的一切都只是常识，我们其实什么都不懂。

sentences.en: And actually, you should be proud of the skills that you have and the qualifications that you hold.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，你应该为你拥有的技能和资质感到自豪。

sentences.en: And actually, other people do respect those enough to pay for them as well.
sentences.zh: 而且，其他人也确实足够尊重这些技能，并愿意为此付费。

sentences.en: And I think it's important that we try and infuse that in the younger people coming up behind us.
sentences.zh: 我认为，我们努力向后辈灌输这一点非常重要。

sentences.en: And whenever I talk to people, whenever I have the opportunity to talk to trainees or assistants or aspiring assistants,
sentences.zh: 每当我与人交谈，每当我有机会与实习生、助理或有志成为助理的人交谈时，

sentences.en: I'm always really trying to talk them up because they naturally already are talking themselves down.
sentences.zh: 我总是非常努力地鼓励他们，因为他们天生就已经在贬低自己了。

sentences.en: I think it's a big problem.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个大问题。

sentences.en: So I'm not surprised by that at all.
sentences.zh: 所以我对此一点也不感到惊讶。

sentences.en: No, but I am saddened by it.
sentences.zh: 不，但我为此感到难过。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And in the whole of my doctorate, I qualified in 2011.
sentences.zh: 在我的整个博士生涯中，我是在2011年获得资格的。

sentences.en: My first private practice client was 2019.
sentences.zh: 我的第一个私人执业客户是在2019年。

sentences.en: So that's eight years later.
sentences.zh: 所以那是八年之后了。

sentences.en: But in the whole of my training, private practice wasn't really mentioned at all.
sentences.zh: 但在我的整个培训过程中，私人执业几乎从未被提及。

sentences.en: Most of the people coming to teach us were working in the NHS.
sentences.zh: 大多数来教我们的人都在NHS工作。

sentences.en: Some maybe had a side hustle.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能还有副业。

sentences.en: But yeah, most were working in the NHS.
sentences.zh: 但确实，大多数人都在NHS工作。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And yeah, like we had one specialist workshop in the third year that you could opt into about private practice.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们在第三年确实有一个关于私人执业的专题研讨会，你可以选择参加。

sentences.en: That ended up being so massively oversubscribed.
sentences.zh: 结果报名人数严重超额。

sentences.en: But that was it, you know, one day talking about private practice.
sentences.zh: 但也就仅此而已，只有一天在谈论私人执业。

sentences.en: But, you know, I think times probably have changed quite a lot since then, especially when I graduated.
sentences.zh: 不过，我认为自那时起，时代可能已经发生了很大变化，尤其是在我毕业的时候。

sentences.en: There were no jobs of my cohort of 16 people that graduated at that time.
sentences.zh: 当时我们那届16个人毕业，根本没有工作机会。

sentences.en: Three people had jobs to go to because of the recession at that time, three people.
sentences.zh: 因为当时的经济衰退，只有三个人有工作可去，只有三个人。

sentences.en: And it took me until the start of December to start my first qualified job because there was just no jobs as a result of the recession from 2008.
sentences.zh: 我直到12月初才开始我的第一份合格工作，因为2008年经济衰退导致根本没有工作岗位。

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: So I think that, yeah, so that changed, that probably changed the narrative around that stage, really.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，是的，那改变了，那可能真的改变了那个阶段的叙事。

sentences.en: Because, you know, the NHS is certainly for training doctorates for the clinical psychology route.
sentences.zh: 因为你知道，NHS当然是为临床心理学方向的博士生提供培训的。

sentences.en: They have no expectation currently of you having to stay in the NHS after you qualify.
sentences.zh: 他们目前并不期望你在获得资格后必须留在NHS。

sentences.en: They can't because they can't guarantee you a job.
sentences.zh: 他们不能，因为他们无法保证给你一份工作。

sentences.en: You know, I actually the trust that trained me didn't have any jobs when I qualified.
sentences.zh: 你知道，实际上，培训我的信托机构在我获得资格时没有任何职位空缺。

sentences.en: I ended up in in a children's trust, you know, 26 miles up the road.
sentences.zh: 我最终去了26英里外的一家儿童信托机构工作。

sentences.en: So you don't owe any allegiances.
sentences.zh: 所以你不需要效忠于谁。

sentences.en: And I think that was kind of quite important to me at that stage to think, well, you know, I was ready to be an NHS employee in the trust that trained me.
sentences.zh: 我认为在那个阶段，对我来说很重要的一点是，好吧，你知道，我准备好成为培训我的信托机构的一名NHS员工了。

sentences.en: But they couldn't sustain their end of that bargain that was never written down, you know?
sentences.zh: 但他们无法维持那份从未写在纸上的协议，你明白吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I do think that's important.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为这很重要。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, for different reasons.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，出于不同的原因。

sentences.en: So when I qualified, there were plenty, I think, of band seven jobs available.
sentences.zh: 所以当我获得资格时，我想有很多七级（Band 7）职位可供选择。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, looking around, there probably are at the moment.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，环顾四周，目前可能也是这样。

sentences.en: But there's nothing if you wanted to go above that, really.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想更进一步，真的就没什么机会了。

sentences.en: And I think that's another thing like the NHS doesn't look after your career progression at all.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是另一件事，NHS根本不关心你的职业发展。

sentences.en: And actually, you know, I'm not an expert on any of this stuff at all.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上，你知道，我根本不是这方面的专家。

sentences.en: But I know that there are people that they get promoted and they end up being told they have to work less hours or their pension contributions go up to the point where they're paying lots back in extra tax,
sentences.zh: 但我知道有些人得到了晋升，结果被告知必须减少工作时间，或者他们的养老金缴款增加到他们需要支付大量额外税款的地步，

sentences.en: which means that they're never really getting any progression in terms of financial pay or really in career satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们在经济收入或职业满意度方面从未真正获得任何进步。

sentences.en: You know, always really shocked me in the NHS that I never met somebody in a consultant post who was allowed to work full time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在NHS里，我从未见过哪位顾问职位的员工被允许全职工作，这总是让我感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: It just didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 这种情况根本没发生过。

sentences.en: So it's like, oh, so you can actually never earn above about 50 grand in the NHS,
sentences.zh: 所以就像是，哦，所以你在NHS里永远无法赚到超过5万英镑，

sentences.en: because as soon as you get to a grade where they would have to pay you that they slush your hours down.
sentences.zh: 因为一旦你达到他们必须支付你那个薪水的级别，他们就会削减你的工作时间。

sentences.en: And I think that's terrible for two reasons.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很糟糕，原因有二。

sentences.en: First, it's terrible for the individuals.
sentences.zh: 首先，这对个人来说很糟糕。

sentences.en: I think we all need progress in our careers in order to feel like we've got that sense of achievement that kind of keeps us growing as people and as professionals.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们都需要职业进步，才能感到自己取得了成就，这种成就感能让我们作为个人和专业人士不断成长。

sentences.en: But I also am really concerned about what it says about the way that we view mental health.
sentences.zh: 但我也非常担心这反映了我们看待心理健康的方式。

sentences.en: If you're refusing to have experienced psychologists who are leading teams there full time, you are not allowing that to happen.
sentences.zh: 如果你拒绝让经验丰富的心理学家全职领导团队，你就不允许这种情况发生。

sentences.en: Then how important is psychology to you, really?
sentences.zh: 那么心理学对你来说到底有多重要呢？

sentences.en: I just I think it is very, very indicative of how psychology is actually viewed in the mental health system that we have in the public sector.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，这非常、非常能说明心理学在我们的公共部门心理健康系统中是如何被看待的。

sentences.en: And it must change and we must be advocating for that change.
sentences.zh: 这种情况必须改变，我们必须倡导这种改变。

sentences.en: And I think the only way we can do that is by showing a better example.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们能做到这一点的唯一方法就是树立一个更好的榜样。

sentences.en: And some of my coaching clients are doing an amazing job of this.
sentences.zh: 我的一些辅导客户在这方面做得非常出色。

sentences.en: I've coached people that are running their own services who are accepting, you know,
sentences.zh: 我辅导过一些经营自己服务的人，他们正在接受，你知道，

sentences.en: local authority and even NHS funded clients into their psychology led services and showing what a blooming good job psychologists can do when they're allowed to properly run a service like full time be in charge of that service.
sentences.zh: 地方当局甚至NHS资助的客户进入他们以心理学为主导的服务机构，并展示了当心理学家被允许全职管理服务时，他们能做出多么出色的工作。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I think there's so much wrong with how the public sector is run at the moment that being blindly loyal to it isn't probably helping anybody.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我认为目前公共部门的运作方式有很多问题，盲目忠诚可能对谁都没有帮助。

sentences.en: But that's not to say I would have liked to have done longer in the NHS and I might go back to it one day if life allows me.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是说我不想在NHS多待一段时间，如果生活允许，我将来可能会回去。

sentences.en: I don't think we need to see it as this big divide.
sentences.zh: 我不认为我们需要把它看作是一道巨大的鸿沟。

sentences.en: But I think what you do need to do is think about your values and what you need right now and make sure that your needs are met and that you're able to live your values through your work.
sentences.zh: 但我认为你需要做的是思考你的价值观和你现在的需求，确保你的需求得到满足，并且你能够通过工作实现你的价值观。

sentences.en: And that might look like a hybrid for you.
sentences.zh: 这可能表现为一种混合模式。

sentences.en: It might look like working only NHS.
sentences.zh: 可能表现为只在NHS工作。

sentences.en: It might look like working only independently.
sentences.zh: 可能表现为只独立执业。

sentences.en: Just be open,
sentences.zh: 保持开放，

sentences.en: be open minded and sort of ground yourself in what's important to your practice and use that as your North Star rather than cutting yourself off from thinking about any options.
sentences.zh: 保持开放的心态，立足于对你的执业重要的事情，并以此作为你的北极星，而不是切断自己思考任何选择的可能性。

sentences.en: Oh, Rosie, I could honestly talk to you for ages and I feel like we're only just, you know, scraping the surface of this.
sentences.zh: 哦，Rosie，我真的可以和你聊很久，我觉得我们才刚刚触及皮毛。

sentences.en: So I might well have to invite you back on later in the year to have this as the the introduction to this.
sentences.zh: 所以我很可能会在今年晚些时候邀请你回来，把这次谈话作为引子。

sentences.en: But we'll perhaps go straight in on a deep dive for some of this stuff later in the year.
sentences.zh: 但我们也许会在今年晚些时候直接深入探讨其中的一些内容。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Could you let us know, you know, about ways people can learn more about you, perhaps how they can follow you on social media, how to follow your sub stack, for example?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们，人们可以通过什么方式更多地了解你，比如他们如何在社交媒体上关注你，如何关注你的Substack，等等吗？

sentences.en: So if you're thinking about going into private practice, we've got everything you need, including a free checklist over at psychology business school dot com.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你正在考虑进入私人执业，我们拥有你需要的一切，包括在psychology business school dot com上的免费清单。

sentences.en: So for private practice stuff, hop over there.
sentences.zh: 所以关于私人执业的内容，去那里看看吧。

sentences.en: I am also quite active on my sub stack at the moment, which is just Dr. Rosie.
sentences.zh: 我目前在我的Substack上也相当活跃，名字就是Dr. Rosie。

sentences.en: The publication's called Know Your Mind.
sentences.zh: 这个出版物叫《了解你的思想》（Know Your Mind）。

sentences.en: So you should be able to find me quite easily there on that.
sentences.zh: 所以你应该很容易在那里找到我。

sentences.en: I talk about the more personal side of business and parenting.
sentences.zh: 我谈论的是商业和育儿中更个人化的一面。

sentences.en: And that's also where you'll find my pregnant and sick stuff around hyperemesis.
sentences.zh: 这也是你会找到我关于妊娠剧吐的怀孕和生病相关内容的地方。

sentences.en: So that's kind of my social media home, if you like.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你喜欢的话，那就是我的社交媒体大本营。

sentences.en: But I'm also on LinkedIn as Dr. Rosanna Gilderthorpe.
sentences.zh: 但我也在LinkedIn上，名字是Dr. Rosanna Gilderthorpe。

sentences.en: And I'm on Instagram as at Rosie Gilderthorpe,
sentences.zh: 我在Instagram上是@Rosie Gilderthorpe，

sentences.en: which is like my business stuff around psychology business school and at the pregnancy psychologist for more of the hyperemesis stuff.
sentences.zh: 那是关于心理学商业学校的商业内容，@the pregnancy psychologist则是更多关于妊娠剧吐的内容。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I'm lots of places, but sub stack is probably the home.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我在很多地方都有账号，但Substack可能是我的大本营。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: And thank you for turning up, even though you've got a cold.
sentences.zh: 也谢谢你即使感冒了也来参加。

sentences.en: You've done amazingly well.
sentences.zh: 你做得非常棒。

sentences.en: So thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 所以非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我。

sentences.en: It's been a real pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这真是一种荣幸。

sentences.en: Oh, likewise.
sentences.zh: 哦，彼此彼此。

sentences.en: Thanks, Rosie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，Rosie。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: What an engaging and inspiring powerhouse Dr. Rosie is, even when she has a cold.
sentences.zh: Dr. Rosie真是一位迷人且鼓舞人心的力量源泉，即使是在她感冒的时候。

sentences.en: Thank you for your time, Rosie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你的时间，Rosie。

sentences.en: Please do go and follow Rosie on all of her social channels, which have been on screen and are in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 请务必去关注Rosie的所有社交频道，这些频道已经在屏幕上显示，并且在节目说明中也有。

sentences.en: And if you'd like to access the checklist she mentioned, please do head to her website.
sentences.zh: 如果你想获取她提到的清单，请前往她的网站。

sentences.en: Do you think it would be useful for me to chat with Dr. Rosie again?
sentences.zh: 你认为我再次与Dr. Rosie聊天会有用吗？

sentences.en: And if so, what questions would you like me to answer or what would you like us to cover?
sentences.zh: 如果是的话，你希望我回答什么问题，或者你希望我们涵盖什么内容？

sentences.en: Please do let me know in the comments or drop me a message on social media where I am Dr. Marianne Trent everywhere.
sentences.zh: 请在评论中告诉我，或者在社交媒体上给我发信息，我在所有平台上都是Dr. Marianne Trent。

sentences.en: If you'd like to help by buying me a cup of herbal tea to say thank you for the content that I create on this podcast, please do.
sentences.zh: 如果你想通过请我喝杯花草茶来表达对我在这个播客中创作内容的感谢，请随意。

sentences.en: There are links in my show notes and in all of my social media channels where my Linktree bio will take you right there.
sentences.zh: 我的节目说明和所有社交媒体频道中都有链接，我的Linktree个人简介会直接带你到那里。

sentences.en: If you would like to check out my masterclass on thinking about going all in into private practice, which you can access by going to my website www.aspiring-psychologiSt.co.uk
sentences.zh: 如果你想查看我的大师课，了解关于全力投入私人执业的想法，你可以通过访问我的网站www.aspiring-psychologiSt.co.uk来获取，

sentences.en: and then going to the learn with me tab.
sentences.zh: 然后进入“跟我学习”（learn with me）标签页。

sentences.en: If you are an aspiring psychologist or for that matter, a qualified psychologist, you might well love reading the Clinical Psychologist Collective,
sentences.zh: 如果你是一位有抱负的心理学家，或者就此而言，是一位合格的心理学家，你可能会喜欢阅读《临床心理学家集体》（The Clinical Psychologist Collective），

sentences.en: which gives lots of lovely real life accounts for people that are practitioner psychologists or were trainee psychologists at the time of writing.
sentences.zh: 它为那些执业心理学家或在写作时是实习心理学家的人提供了许多可爱的真实生活记录。

sentences.en: There's also the Aspiring Psychologist Collective, which gets wonderful reviews.
sentences.zh: 还有《有抱负的心理学家集体》（Aspiring Psychologist Collective），它获得了极好的评价。

sentences.en: And if you or someone you care about is autistic and wondering how you could begin to go about forging a career
sentences.zh: 如果你或你关心的人是自闭症患者，并且想知道如何开始在心理健康领域开创职业生涯，

sentences.en: in mental health, then an autistic anthology is the most brilliant book for you.
sentences.zh: 那么《自闭症选集》（an autistic anthology）就是为你准备的最棒的书。

sentences.en: If you would welcome some more support, care, guidance and advice for nurturing your development in psychology,
sentences.zh: 如果你欢迎在心理学领域的发展中获得更多的支持、关怀、指导和建议，

sentences.en: please do consider the Aspiring Psychologist membership, which you can join from just £30 a month.
sentences.zh: 请考虑加入“有抱负的心理学家会员计划”（Aspiring Psychologist membership），每月仅需30英镑起。

sentences.en: We have all of our bases covered in terms of research, in terms of CBT skills and formulation,
sentences.zh: 我们在研究、CBT技能和案例构思方面涵盖了所有基础知识，

sentences.en: in terms of professional issues and models, approaches, theories, confidence, interview tips, skills and practice and so much more.
sentences.zh: 在专业问题和模型、方法、理论、信心、面试技巧、技能和实践等方面也涵盖了很多。

sentences.en: Head to my website www.aspiring-psychologiSt.co.uk and click membership.
sentences.zh: 前往我的网站www.aspiring-psychologiSt.co.uk并点击会员计划。

sentences.en: You can also head to that same website and get your free psychology success guide, which also gets great feedback.
sentences.zh: 你也可以前往同一个网站获取你的免费心理学成功指南，它也获得了很好的反馈。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在寻求成为一名心理学家，那么让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to being qualified.
sentences.zh: 有这个播客在你身边，你将走上获得资格的道路。

sentences.en: It's the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 这是Dr. Marianne Trent主持的《有抱负的心理学家播客》。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 各位心理学家，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱以外的收入，会怎样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性的收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息要告诉大家。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己是在2022年完成该项目的，此后我也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的转型之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲提供的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外付费。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师课、个性化指导、一份福特纳姆和梅森的礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 请通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，随时可以找我。
